_comment: Stage F2a CURATED RESPIN configuration (2026-07-21, user decision at the F1 fork): the Castalia defaults with (1) the CQ AFE register stubs + EIS stub dropped and QSPI0 instantiated in page-0 slot 12 @0x4C00 (peripherals.cqAfeStubs=false, qspi=true; vectors 55/56), (2) RTC0 in MUTEX page sub-slot 5 @0x6500 (rtc=true; vector 114), (3) PWM0 in MUTEX page sub-slot 6 @0x6600 (pwm=true; vectors 115/116, outputs on P2.2/P2.3 AF2), and (4) DMA0 in MUTEX page sub-slot 8 @0x6800 with the 2-CHANNEL knob (dma=true, dmaChannels=2; vectors 118/119; widens the shared fabric to 5 masters). I3C, NFC, and OneWire are OFF: I3C has an unresolved pad dependency, NFC's RF partner is off-die, and OW's only pin P6.6 is unbonded on the QFN-44 (package scope for this re-cut = GPIO4/5 pads only). Vector 117 (ex-OW) is RSVD per the global vector-tail rule; vectorsCount = 120 so the PENDX/INSVCX rider rows are live. The NPU stays ON. Everything included reaches existing bonded pins. Prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_dp.json
_comment_package: Stage G2 (2026-07-22, user pick): LARGE package — LQFP-100 (castalia-lqfp100 model), the QFN-44 is retired as the respin target. First package to bond all 48 GPIO (P5/P6 included) + POC. preliminary stays true until bonding is confirmed. NOTE: OW/I3C pins are now bondable, but the user kept them OUT of this config (2026-07-22 §4.3 decision) — the CastaliaDP netlist stands.
